other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Unsupervised feature transformations (like TF-IDF, SVD, or categorical frequency encoding) are fit on the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the out-of-fold validation scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent implements a comprehensive stacked ensemble with extensive feature engineering and proper out-of-fold target encoding. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the food recall data by using a randomized cross-validation split, leading to look-ahead bias. Additionally, it leaks validation set information into the training folds by fitting unsupervised transformations (TF-IDF, SVD, frequency encoding) on the entire training set prior to the cross-validation loop.
